code_summary: No work order indicator code. Checked: ocmsadminapi/ocmsadminprivateapi (entities/fields/cron), ocmsadminui (notice detail, NoticeSearch, Report). No work order indicator or validity period field on notices
note: The story asks that notices under IDs in a work order get a special indicator and the work order validity period, shown when browsing. No code: grep for work order, indicator, validity period, wo_ across the six repos found no field/column, cron or UI component for this. Since work orders are never created (OCMS34.13), there is no data source to trigger an indicator. The only trace is the 'Workorder Reports' stub in the staff UI, commented out (ReportList.tsx:147-201) with an empty resource (ReportListWorkOrder.tsx:48). I only checked via grep; DB columns outside the repo (possibly existing in the database) cannot verify from repo. Story status is blank in stories.json (requirement not given). No matching maintenance ticket (grep work order/warrant/tagging/house visit in maintenance_tickets.csv: 0).
recommendation: Do not claim. No work order indicator or validity period on notices.
